episodes.title: #DaJumpoff (DOCTRINE)
episodes.summary: Brooklyn artist Nola lays down her philosophy on sex and freedom between visits from her three lovers: thoughtful Jamie, playful Mars and cocky Greer.

episodes.title: #BootyFull (SELF ACCEPTANCE)
episodes.summary: While Nola works through the aftermath of a disturbing encounter, her friend Shemekka considers changing her body to boost her earning potential.

episodes.title: #LBD (LITTLE BLACK DRESS)
episodes.summary: After a setback, Nola tries to regain her power and confidence with help from a little black dress. But the effect isn't what she hoped.

episodes.title: #LuvIsLuv (SEXUALITY IS FLUID)
episodes.summary: Fed up with the toxic energy in her life, Nola embarks on a man cleanse. That doesn't mean her lovin' bed is empty, though.

episodes.title: #4MyNegusAndMyBishes (ALL WORDS MATTER)
episodes.summary: Nola faces challenges at her new teaching job, Jamie learns his son has made a startling viral video, and Shemekka takes a decisive step.

episodes.title: #HeGotItAllMixedUp (DYSLEXIA)
episodes.summary: Emotions run high as Nola prepares for her art opening -- and her men realize they aren't invited to the big night. Shemekka makes her dancing debut.

episodes.title: #HowToMakeLoveToANegroWithoutGettingTired
episodes.summary: Greer decides it's time to break the rules. Meanwhile, Nola stews over a review from a critic, and Jamie slips into a confusing spiral.

episodes.title: #LoveDontPayDaRent (IF YOU DON'T KNOW ME BY NOW)
episodes.summary: Nola veers between joy and panic when two sudden changes of fortune leave her scrambling to cover her bills. Jamie turns to an old friend for help.

episodes.title: #ChangeGonCome (GENTRIFICATION)
episodes.summary: Amid rising tensions in the neighborhood, Nola tries to channel all her energy into her art. But she soon finds herself thrust into the spotlight.

episodes.title: #NolasChoice (3 DA HARD WAY)
episodes.summary: Awkward surprises, a bold new work of art and the sweet sounds of Prince turn a holiday feast into an unforgettable night.

episodes.title: #I'mFeelingMyFeelings
episodes.summary: Eighteen months later, as Nola navigates a committed relationship with Opal, Mars finds himself out of work and in need of a place to crash.

episodes.title: #ConeyIslandIsTheEndOfTheLine
episodes.summary: Amid rising tensions with Opal, Nola weighs an offer to use her street art in an ad campaign and has an unsettling run-in at Skylar's school.

episodes.title: #LuvStings
episodes.summary: Feeling raw, Nola cleans house and goes back to therapy. Meanwhile, Shemekka returns to the motel where she got her injections.

episodes.title: #NationTime
episodes.summary: In Martha's Vineyard, Nola gets a chance to learn from artists like Carrie Mae Weems and Amy Sherald. But an unwelcome surprise throws her off her game.

episodes.title: #SuperFunkyCaliFragiSexy
episodes.summary: As Brooklyn celebrates Prince at the Purple People Party, Nola snaps portraits for earWave. Septima rehearses a play with George C. Wolfe.

episodes.title: #WhenYourChickensComeHometoRoost
episodes.summary: Clorinda contends with mounting pressure from Danton and romantic tensions with Mars. Skylar confronts Nola about her relationship with Jamie.

episodes.title: #OhJudoKnow?
episodes.summary: Nola, Mars, Shemekka and Winny take an eye-opening trip to San Juan, Puerto Rico, to deliver money for hurricane relief efforts.

episodes.title: #OnTheComeUpTheComeDown&TheComeRound
episodes.summary: During a launch party for her hair care line, Shemekka forces Nola and Clo to hash out their problems. The earWave campaign takes a maddening turn.

episodes.title: #IAmYourMirror
episodes.summary: Friends, former lovers and fellow artists turn out for Nola's first solo show, where a provocative new piece stirs up strong emotions.
